messages:
ravi: Heads-up: smell test on cert-provisioner across eu-central found intermittent CA chain mismatches. Not widespread but reproducible on a canary node.
emily: what's the timeline? any KMS unwraps off-hours?
sec-rotator-bot: ALERT: rotator observed unexpected issuer fingerprint for service=cert-provisioner-eu-central (id=rotator-77) at 2025-02-11T01:12Z. Shadow cert provisioned.
lee: I see Decrypt events at 2025-02-11T00:59Z from principal:svc:rotator-eu:ephemeral-2025-02-11T00:57Z and another from principal:infra-cicd@infra.example.com.
nina: infra-cicd did a short-lived role grant last week for an emergency deploy. ravi: do we have the IAM change diff?
ravi: grabbing iam diff now. there's a binding created on 2025-02-10T23:45Z with note "temp: allow rotator cross-region test". creator is user:ops-bot@infra.example.com (automated).
emily: ops-bot initiated via a Jenkins job? ping infra.
oncall-marc: oncall here, I'll take if we escalate. needs forensics if external principals used KMS.
lee: mitigation plan: 1) revoke temp binding 2) rotate affected certs to shadow 3) extend KMS audit retention for these keys 4) run provenance sweep 5) scan other regions for similar artifacts. assigning ravi + nina.
ravi: running rotate: `./tools/rotator rotate --service cert-provisioner-eu-central --use-shadow`
sec-rotator-bot: Rotate complete. Canary traffic healthy. No external CSR observed.
emily: good. still need to map pipeline logs; infra says job was a one-off triggered by admin user. request logs show CLI user agent from 35.196.44.12 which maps to infra-runner-host-12.
lee: odd external principal still in Decrypt logs. could be downstream ACME provider webhook. anyone have egress flow logs?
nina: pulling egress flows now. `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.connection.dest_ip=35.200.12.9' --limit 50` shows connection to acme-provider-cdn with user-agent acme-client/2.1.
oncall-marc: keep legal in loop. I'll coordinate notifications if this crosses customers.
sec-rotator-bot: NOTE: Shadow certs will be promoted at 2025-02-11T04:00Z unless a rollback is posted.
